thread:
ava: Quick heads-up — plan to lift runtime pin for autoscaler-service (runtime 5.0.1 -> 5.1.0) in the 02:30-03:15 UTC change window. Fixes a scheduling hotspot and improves tenant isolation. Need perf and release-note ack. Any objections?
rafi: what's the rollback criteria and canary plan? we've had multi-tenant regressions before.
ava: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with manual hold before final ramp. Automatic rollback if multi-tenant p95 increases >250ms sustained 5m OR cross-tenant error_rate>1%. Deploybot will reapply pin to 5.0.1 on trigger.
deploybot: Scheduled. Gates: "perf/preflight==pass" and "release-notes/draft==yes". Will post stage metrics.
chloe: perf request: add a tenant-isolation smoke that runs synthetic multi-tenant bursts for 15m during preflight. If isolation fails, abort.
ava: added tenant-isolation preflight at 01:50 (15m). perf-bot, please run.
perf-bot: tenant-isolation preflight queued at 01:50. Will report PASS/FAIL.
marc: also add a quick SDK compatibility check — autoscaler control-plane header changed in 5.1.0 and older SDKs might ignore fallback. Gate on "sdk/compat==ok".
ava: good catch. gating updated. We will not execute final ramp until SDK compat is confirmed.
perf-bot: PRELIGHT PASS at 02:06 UTC. Tenant isolation looks stable on synthetic bursts; p95 within baseline.
deploybot: Gates cleared (perf/preflight==pass, release-notes/draft==yes, sdk/compat==ok). Canary started 02:34 -> 5% routing. Initial metrics: latency -3%, errors flat. Advancing to 25% at 02:42.
rafi: seeing a creeping p95 in tenant group T-42 after 25% bump (+270ms). Not above rollback threshold yet but close.
chloe: traces point to increased queue hold in the autoscaler control loop for that tenant group. Could be a scheduling mismatch for noisy tenants.
ava: HOLD final ramp. deploybot: pause at 25% and start deeper trace capture for T-42.
deploybot: Holding at 25% and capturing traces.
perf-bot: captured traces and opened ticket #2044: "autoscaler scheduling delay on noisy tenant cohort T-42". Early hypothesis: contention between delayed rebalance and the new scheduler heuristics.
marc: given the risk to high-value tenant, recommend rollback and investigate offline rather than risk full rollout.
ava: agree. deploybot, execute rollback to 5.0.1 and reapply pin.
deploybot: Executing rollback -> applying runtime pin=5.0.1. Command: `deploybot rollback --target runtime=5.0.1 --reason "p95 drift T-42 during canary"`.
deploybot: Rollback complete at 02:53 UTC. Runtime pinned back to 5.0.1. Notifying oncall and creating incident ticket.
rafi: thanks. Please add action items: (1) simulate noisy tenant workload in staging with new scheduler, (2) add an isolation throttle in the scheduler, (3) re-run canary after fixes.
ava: added to ticket #2044 and updated release notes: "unpin attempt aborted; rollback executed due to tenant p95 drift; scheduler heuristics under investigation." Will reschedule after test coverage and throttle added.
chloe: tagging the noisy-tenant owners for repro steps.
ava: closing thread now; follow-ups in #release-notes and ticket #2044. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
